summary: Attempt A: read-side time-window token correlation. daemon.js taskTokens now falls back to harnessTranscriptForTask() — picks the same-session agent whose [startedAt,endedAt] best-overlaps the task's claim window (overlay timestamps firstSeen..lastChanged) and uses its transcript_path. Direct-assignee transcript still wins. Exported taskTokens/harnessTranscriptForTask under require.main guard for testability. New test/token-attr.test.js (5 assertions) + existing native-write test both PASS. node --check passes. Commit 84cb49f. Tradeoff: heuristic; if two harness agents in one session overlap a claim it picks max-overlap (could misattribute on concurrent same-session subagents), but zero protocol/hook changes.
